versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the rbw skill (v1.0.0)
- Provides commands for unlocking, listing, retrieving, syncing, and adding Bitwarden/Vaultwarden items using the rbw CLI
- Includes detailed usage patterns for interactive and non-interactive/systemd environments, with secure authentication examples
- Documents folder and field access, custom field handling, and script integration practices
- Offers troubleshooting steps, error handling guidance, and best practices for secure automation
